source='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    target = max((v for v in counts if v != background), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    markers = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == target]

    eligible = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                if grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != target}
    components = []
    while eligible:
        start = eligible.pop()
        comp = {start}
        q = [start]
        while q:
            r, c = q.pop()
            for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if p in eligible:
                    eligible.remove(p)
                    comp.add(p)
                    q.append(p)
        components.append(comp)
    motif = max(components, key=len)
    minr, maxr = min(r for r,c in motif), max(r for r,c in motif)
    minc, maxc = min(c for r,c in motif), max(c for r,c in motif)
    frequencies = Counter(grid[r][c] for r,c in motif)
    common = max(frequencies.values())
    candidates = [(r,c) for r,c in motif if frequencies[grid[r][c]] == common]
    center = ((minr+maxr)/2, (minc+maxc)/2)
    ar, ac = min(candidates, key=lambda p: (p[0]-center[0])**2+(p[1]-center[1])**2)

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pattern = [(r-ar, c-ac, grid[r][c]) for r,c in motif]
    for mr, mc in markers:
        for dr, dc, color in pattern:
            rr, cc = mr+dr, mc+dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
'''
